title: Re-study firstmate work handling and add pin-consistency check
summary: Retry of job be8x. Re-derive the firstmate work-handling study from the mounted source so a newcomer reading index.html finds teardown reopening a backlog item, yolo self-merge, and places freed only by a recorded PR or cleanup. Add a pin-consistency check in rules.rs with tests.

defaults_applied.how: Check and tests are written in Rust.
New pin-consistency test including a mismatch case; cargo test and clippy pass.
Criteria check quotes exist at the pinned commit and the page content, not file existence.
Every claim cites path, quote and line at the pinned commit.
No secrets or personal data written.
Study re-derived from source, with a code check against pin drift.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Audience: an outside reader or independent reviewer checking the explainer against the pinned firstmate source.
The mounted source commit is the single pin; if pin.json or labels differ, they are re-pinned to the mounted commit and CHANGELOG records it.
Gate commands (test, run site, clippy, fmt) are run by the producer and their results reported; they are not content criteria.
The earlier plan's deliverable list is reused; xtask/src/site.rs changes only if the rebuild needs it.

acceptance_criteria.text: rules.rs (or its caller) has a check comparing the mounted source commit, pin.json sha, and the sha label on every source in claims.json and rationales.json; on mismatch it fails with a message naming the differing values.
pin.json and every citation label name one identical commit, the one the quotes were read from; CHANGELOG states the pin decision and any re-pin.

claims.json has cited claims (path, quote, line) that teardown can reopen a backlog item instead of closing it and under which condition; that with yolo on firstmate merges green work itself and what happens with yolo off; and that only a recorded PR or cleanup frees a place, with relaunches and secondmates never counted.

model.json, rationales.json, findings.json and intro.json agree with the claims, reference only existing claim ids, and say local-only ships and scouts hold their place until cleanup rather than being freed by a recorded PR.
The rebuilt index.html shows the three corrected behaviors, each citing the pinned commit, with quoted lines that exist at that commit.
The final report includes a table mapping each requirement to evidence (file and line or command output).
Run `cargo test`: all pass, including the new pin-consistency test and its mismatched-label rejection case, and the xtask site tests.
Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`: succeeds with no unknown claim id error and renders index.html. Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: clean.
No secrets or personal data are written.

out_of_scope: Changing the harness completion gate or report format
Studying systems other than firstmate work handling
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
departures: Prior attempt failed; the job bundles code, study re-derivation and site rebuild, so cost, time and pass rate are worse than reference.
